reviews.title: Great NAS system
reviews.comment: Great NAS system. Hasn’t gone down or had any errors so far (well over a year of uptime now). Apps for interfacing with it to backup and access files through smartphone are also very good and easy to use.
reviews.author: Vladimir

reviews.title: Great for Plex
reviews.comment: Works great for my Plex server
reviews.author: Customer

reviews.title: No regrets with this purchase.
reviews.comment: Love it. I bought this to replace a well out of date Synology NAS.  I've been using it now for several months with no problems.  I've added containers to it and now and use it to host my local webserver and my Pi-hole DNS filter.  A solid performer.
reviews.author: ChunkyC
